verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents an official SDK for embedding and customizing the builder inside a SaaS app, and a TypeScript framework for building pieces, so a first-party SDK surface exists. However, the evidence never describes general-purpose API client SDKs, language coverage, or SDK reference depth, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all paths. Missing for 10: documented official API client SDKs (multiple languages), SDK reference documentation depth, published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: You can use the SDK to embed and customize Activepieces in your SaaS
